answer: Forget banning accounts after the fact. Proof of unique business tax ID registration stops them at the door: a tax ID registered once and filing every year since, which means the ledge of a farm is set before it earns a single coin. Fakes fail here because a tax ID registered once and filing every year since is tied to something outside the network; the vine of the attack is that the farm must now operate in the physical world, where clones are slow and visible. One clone is cheap; a hundred are a small business with no revenue. The basalt is the point where the farm's spreadsheet turns red.
